title: Shipping cost from a config whose kind is one of three values
task: Our shipping configuration has a `Kind` that is one of three values: `flat` (a fixed fee), `weight` (a rate per kilogram, weight rounded up to whole kilograms), and `free` (no charge when the subtotal is at or above a threshold, otherwise the flat fee). In package `shipping`, build a shipping policy from a `Config` struct with `Kind string`, `FeeCents int64`, `PerKgCents int64`, and `FreeAboveCents int64`, and give it a `Cost(order Order) int64`. I expect to add a fourth kind next quarter, so please make that cheap to do. Test each kind with one order.
